card.name: Words just before the word cases
card.fires_on: Modifiers or linking words right before an expected 'cases' or 'reports', such as 'fatal', 'additional', 'rare', 'are' or 'thousands of'. Mostly in adverse-event reporting sentences.

modes.label: Qualifier before cases
modes.description: An adjective like fatal or additional placed just before the word cases in a postmarketing safety sentence.
modes.example: Lactic acidosis and severe hepatomegaly with steatosis, including<< fatal>> cases, have been reported with the use

modes.label: Linking word before reports
modes.description: A verb or quantity word that leads into reports or cases of an event.
modes.example: but there<< are>> reports of it occurring several months to years

card.writes: It pushes the model to output the word 'cases' (and its Chinese equivalent) next.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before 'cases' is expected, as in 'including fatal cases'.
